headline: Celeste King
bio: I look closely at birds, moss, weather, and the animals that pause long enough to be seen. Then I draw what stays after I look away.
The photographs are field notes. The illustrations wander into myth, character, and the slightly strange. The sketchbook is where both of those start, unfinished on purpose.

focus.title: Sketchbook
focus.text: Warm-ups, studies, and pages that never had to be done.
